budget_items.topic: Town new growth (Board of Assessors / Town Manager report)

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Bridge small bridge grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: MassDOT agreed to extend a Small Bridge Grant through December 31, 2027.

budget_items.topic: FY26 budget adjustments (Article 2) for the Finance Department transition

budget_items.topic: Retiree health insurance overrun and funding options

budget_items.quote: retiree health insurance came in approximately $100,000 higher than budgeted but expects that can be absorbed through existing contingency funds
